text:
laura: Quick preflight before we flip the canary for cc-bert-3b — can everyone confirm weights location, tokenizer gotchas, and whether the golden-prompt/regression evals are green? planning to run tool-calling smoke as well.

sanjay: Weights are at s3://redwood-models/cc-bert/3b/v2026-03-15/cc-bert-3b.pt (tag: v3-20260315). Uploaded last night, checksum: `sha256:9f3a...b2c7`.

eva: Tokenizer note: this model uses a SentencePiece model with legacy unk mapping. The old runtime expects `</s>` as eos index 1 but the new loader maps eos->2. We should validate by running tokenization on the golden prompts. Config snippet:```
spiece_model: tokenizer/cc-bert-v3.model
config:
  bos_token: "<s>"
  eos_token: "</s>"
  unk_token: "<unk>"
```

chris: Heads up: my local structured-output eval flagged a schema mismatch for the tool-calling responses. The `tools` field is sometimes returned as a string instead of array for the math tool. Example failing output: `{"answer": "42", "tools": "math_v1"}` — should be `"tools": ["math_v1"]`.

laura: @chris can you paste the PR or failing op? i'll add it to the canary checklist. Also @sanjay please confirm model config has `structured_output: true`.

sanjay: Confirmed in model.yaml:```
model_name: cc-bert-3b
structured_output: true
max_sequence_length: 2048
quantized: false
```

chris: PR with failing example: https://github.com/redwood-inference/cc-bert/pull/82 — test case `test_tool_output_array` currently failing on CI. I suspect tokenizer->serializer layer is collapsing single-element arrays.

eva: I'll run a quick tokenization target on the golden prompts and check token id ordering vs runtime. If eos index mismatch is the culprit, it could explain off-by-one in serialized toolcall payloads.

infra-bot: canary preflight checks: weights accessible: OK, checksum matches: OK, runtime image build queued: #build-4321, expected ETA 12m.

laura: Action items - (1) @eva run tokenization diff and post snippet; (2) @chris add defensive serializer test (array coercion); (3) @sanjay confirm model endpoint toggles `allow_tool_calling: true` in route config; (4) i'll wait for infra build and then kick off golden/regression eval job. Please reply with :thumbsup: when done.

eva: Tokenization diffs: ran 50 golden prompts — 2 cases where eos landed at index 2 vs expected 1 in old runtime. Dump:```
prompt: "Calculate tax for $100"
old_ids: [101, 345, 789, 1]
new_ids: [101, 345, 789, 2]
```
I'll open a tiny patch to the tokenizer loader to remap eos for compatibility.

chris: I pushed a test and a small serializer guard in the PR; CI rerun queued.

laura: infra build passed :white_check_mark: — build-4321 image: `redwood/serve:cc-bert-v3-20260315`. Starting evals now (golden + toolcall smoke). I'll post results in this thread.

infra-bot: eval job queued: job_id=eval-9812 (golden+toolcall), expected runtime ~6m.

chris: CI for serializer PR is green locally; waiting on GitHub CI. pinging review: @laura @sanjay :eyes:.

laura: Got it — thanks. If CI passes, ship the serializer patch to the canary branch before flipping traffic.

infra-bot: eval job completed: eval-9812 -> golden: PASS(98/100), toolcall-smoke: FAIL(1/12) — failing case: `math_v1` returned string in tools field again.

chris: The failing case is reproducible on canary image with serialized token eos mismatch. The serializer guard prevented many cases but not the single-element string scenario coming from the tool runtime. I'll add a defensive coerce in the tool adapter as well.

laura: OK — new plan: merge tokenizer loader remap + serializer guard + tool-adapter coercion to canary, rerun evals. This shouldn't take more than a couple PRs. Can someone add a short checklist to the PR description to ensure we don't skip the structured-output unit test?

sanjay: I'll add the route config check and a small smoke script to `infra/playbooks/canary_preflight.sh` that validates `structured_output` + tokenization sample.

laura: Great. Thanks all — please update this thread when your PRs are merged so i can flip the canary. :shipit:
